name: Thandie Mabhena
source:
Thandie is the eldest of five princesses. As heir to the throne, the crushing responsibility forces her to seek relief in the most unusual of ways.

Thandie dreams of running off with a lowly peasant girl and living the life of simplicity and solitude in the arms of her love.

But honor and duty bind her to her family and her sisters. If only there was a way to escape this life filled with wealth and corruption?

[From [url=https://dumbkoala.art/MeetTheCast/info.php?name=Thandie]DumbKoala[/url]]
